units: Dimensionless. Rosenbrock algebraic roots and one1D Dirichlet Bratu stencil are separate controls.

outcome_matrix.all_three_methods: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no success expected or selected from output
DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; either branch or explicit nonconvergence category is retained

dogleg.variables: Euclidean state metric D=I; ||p||2<=Delta. S is ONLY the fixed left residual scaling, with no state-dependent rescaling.
dogleg.definitions: f=S F(x), A=S J(x), g=A^T f, B=A^T A; m(p)=.5||f+A p||2^2. Predicted decrease=.5||f||2^2-.5||f+A p||2^2; actual decrease=phi(x)-phi(x+p).
dogleg.Gauss_Newton_endpoint: pB is the minimum-Euclidean-norm least-squares solution of A p=-f, computed with a fixed SVD rank cutoff sigma>1e-12*max(m,n)*sigma_max. Save all singular values, rank and least-squares residual; no hidden regularization. A singular/rank-deficient Jacobian is not itself root success.
dogleg.Cauchy_endpoint: If g nonzero and ||A g||2^2>0, pU=-(g^T g)/(||A g||2^2)*g. If ||pU||>=Delta, choose -Delta*g/||g||. Otherwise take pB when inside the ball, or pU+t(pB-pU) at the unique t in[0,1] on ||p||=Delta.
dogleg.degenerate_cases: At unscaled root criterion, return ROOT first. If g exactly zero and original residual fails, return STATIONARY_NONROOT. Nonzero g with nonpositive/nonfinite ||Ag||2^2, rank-solver failure or unrepresentable model returns MODEL_DEGENERATE/MODEL_FAILURE with current f/A/g/p candidates; no division, floor or fallback Newton step. Coincident pU/pB is handled by the already tested inside-ball endpoint.
dogleg.ratio: rho=actual/predicted only if predicted>0 and finite. Predicted<=0 is MODEL_FAILURE, not a zero/NaN numeric CSV ratio.
dogleg.acceptance: Accept iff predicted>0, actual>0 and rho>=.1. Otherwise reject and keep x unchanged.
dogleg.radius_update: After a finite valid trial: rho<.25 => Delta_new=.25Delta; else if rho>.75 and ||p||>=.99Delta => min(2Delta,100); else Delta_new=Delta. rho<=0 follows the shrink branch. A domain-rejected trial also shrinks by.25 and consumes one trial. Delta<2^-40 terminates TRUST_RADIUS_EXHAUSTED.
dogleg.trial_cap: At most25 trial steps per accepted outer iterate, at most80 outer iterations. Keep all rejected states. No automatic retry with new starts or larger caps.
dogleg.stable_predicted_decrease: Compute pred=-sum(g*p)-.5*sum((A*p)^2) with explicit matrix-vector contraction; save direct .5||f||²-.5||f+Ap||² too. Compare the two under64*eps*max(1,phi,||g||||p||,||Ap||²). Acceptance uses the stable quadratic expression; no postoutput formula switch.

line_search: Use the same phi and exact gradient g. A descent Newton/least-squares direction requires g^T p<0; otherwise return NONDESCENT_DIRECTION/STATIONARY_NONROOT as appropriate. Try alpha=2^-j,j=0..24, accept phi(x+alpha*p)<=phi(x)+1e-4*alpha*g^T*p. Preserve all rejected/domain trials and count all F evaluations.
negative_fixtures: F(x)=x^2+1,x0=0: stationary nonroot, not successful convergence
Reject and save a deliberately unrepresentable exp trial before evaluation

reference_components.oracle: Exact rational endpoints and independent Decimal60 quadratic intersection for the intermediate radius.
Minimum-norm pGN=(-1,0), boundary step=(-.5,0), rank1; residual second component is irreducible.
g0 with positive residual =>STATIONARY_NONROOT, never root.

implementation_note: Use fixed-input arrays; no initial-value/parameter sweep or postfailure start selection. Full Newton diagnostics are retained even when not roots.
